name: TempleDAO StaxLPStaking unrestricted migrateStake
summary: StaxLPStaking.migrateStake(oldStaking, amount) called migrateWithdraw on a caller-supplied oldStaking address without checking it was a known staking contract, then credited amount as the caller's stake. The attacker passed its own contract as oldStaking, was credited the contract's whole xFraxTempleLP balance and withdrew it.
notes: The staked xFraxTempleLP has no DefiLlama price; it is valued at the WETH the attacker realised when it unwound the position through the xLP/LP pool, the LP and the Temple AMM (rule 15), priced in ETH at block time.

Nine later migrateStake calls by other addresses up to block 15800000 moved nothing (the contract was empty), so the campaign is empty; the deployer created no sibling StaxLPStaking before the exploit.
